notes.text:
2015 Reissue / Limited to 300 Copies
Sleeve is a generic white cover with xerox color copy of front/rear artwork glued. No credits on spine.
The labels are slightly different from the original:
- the original font is taller
- the most visible difference is the way the speed is printed with "1/3" written as such in the unofficial (this) release while on the original it is in "fraction character" i.e. "⅓ " (i.e. smaller numbers and placed in a different position)
- different pressing ring in roughly the same position but with an sharp edge on the original and a rounded one on the unofficial
